name: Chura Sabzi
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a pan and sauté finely chopped onions, ginger, and garlic until golden brown.
2. Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, and local green chilies, cooking until the tomatoes soften.
3. Add the crumbled fermented yak cheese (Chura) into the mixture.
4. Pour in a little water to adjust the consistency to a thick gravy.
5. Simmer on low heat until the cheese melts and blends with the spices.
6. Season with salt and serve hot with steamed rice.
description: Chura Sabzi is a quintessential dish of the Monpa tribe in Arunachal Pradesh. It highlights the use of yak milk products, which are vital to the high-altitude lifestyle of the region. The dish is known for its intense, pungent flavor profile derived from the fermented cheese and is a comforting staple during cold weather.
